Name: Shebna, Scribe
Summary: Shebna the scribe stood with Eliakim and Joah before the Rabshakeh's threats and carried his words to Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Shebna hears the Rabshakeh and reports to Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Eliakim, Son of Hilkiah; Joah, Son of Asaph; Isaiah
LifeLesson: Hearing threats and carrying them to prayer is itself faithful service.
